title: Replace editable actor text input in topbar with a proper identity display pill
goal: The topbar currently shows an editable <input type='text'> field (id='actor-input') inside the actor pill, allowing any user to type any actor name and assume any role. This is a testing/development mechanism that should not be visible as a product UI element. Replace the editable input with a read-only display of the current actor name and role badge. The actor name should still be changeable via the Settings screen (Instance / Shell Identity section) where it belongs, not via a live-editable topbar field. The displayed name and 'J' avatar initial should update when the actor name changes via Settings. Keep the localStorage-backed actor persistence logic but route changes through Settings instead of the topbar input.
scope: System review 2026-05-01: The topbar actor pill contains an active <input type='text'> field. Operators can type any name and assume any role without authentication. This looks like a development tool exposed in production UI. Enterprise operators should not see a live-editable identity field in the application shell.

success_criteria: The topbar actor area shows the actor name and role badge as read-only text, not an editable input.
The displayed avatar initial (currently hardcoded 'J') updates to reflect the first letter of the current actor name.
Actor name can still be changed via Settings > Instance / Shell Identity.
The x_actor_fallback authentication method continues to work via the actor name set in Settings.
No regression in actor-dependent approval gate tests.

acceptance_criteria: No <input> element in the topbar actor area.
Actor name readable and correct from Settings.
